rules.name: Suppress missing data map objects for uninstalled mods
rules.pattern: Object with ID .* specified in data map for registry .* doesn't exist

rules.name: Suppress Mod Menu broken icon warnings
rules.pattern: (Invalid mod icon for icon source|Warning! Mod .* has a broken icon)

rules.name: Suppress development environment refmap warnings
rules.pattern: Reference map '.*' for .* could not be read

rules.name: Suppress missing accesstransformer warnings
rules.pattern: Access transformer file META-INF/accesstransformer\.cfg provided by mod .* does not exist

rules.name: Suppress Spelunkery generated resources warnings
rules.pattern: Failure adding generated resources from spelunkery:overrides/loot_table/

rules.name: Suppress invalid path in pack warnings
Suppress Polytone missing grass ID warning
rules.pattern: Found missing ID in minecraft namespace: minecraft:grass

rules.name: Suppress Moonlight Fabric API notice
rules.pattern: Fabric API detected! This is not a Fabric mod
